summary.title: Torch ABI mismatch in native extensions
root_causes: 7 torch ABI symbols unresolved in _C.abi3.so and _rocm_C.abi3.so (e.g., c10::TensorImpl::incref_pyobject(), c10::MessageLogger::stream[abi:cxx11]())
Native extension import fails with undefined symbol _ZNK3c1010TensorImpl15incref_pyobjectEv
vllm-server cannot boot due to failed native extension imports
Secondary: tokenizers==0.23.1 conflicts with transformers requirement (>=0.22.0,<=0.23.0)
summary.recommended_action: Rebuild vLLM 0.19.1.dev3 native extensions against torch 2.9.1+rocm7.13.0 to resolve c10 symbol mismatches, or ensure the prebuilt wheel was compiled with the exact same torch/ROCm version pair. Update tokenizers to <=0.23.0 if needed.
